result.instructions: Tools for Max CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which leads in Max CRM have an appointment scheduled this week?"; "Show the notes and recent activity for lead 4821."; "Add a new lead for Ana Lee, phone 555-014-2000, final expense.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Max CRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run maxcrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run maxcrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run maxcrm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. maxcrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: maxcrm_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Show the Max CRM account behind the key: token access (full or read only), today's usage, limits and lead routing. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: maxcrm_get_reference
tools.title: Get allowed values
tools.description: List the allowed lead statuses, lead types, origins, webhook events and limits. Use it before setting a status or lead type. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/reference.

tools.name: maxcrm_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List leads, newest first. Filter by status, source, phone or updated_since. Page with next_cursor. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/leads.

status.description: Pipeline status, for example new_lead or appointment_scheduled. maxcrm_get_reference lists them all.

phone.description: Only this phone (any format; the last 10 digits are used).

updated_since.description: Only leads changed at or after this time.

tools.name: maxcrm_get_lead
tools.title: Get a lead
tools.description: Show one lead by id, including monthly_premium, coverage_amount, policy_number and vendor when set. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/leads/{id}.

tools.name: maxcrm_list_lead_notes
tools.title: List lead notes
tools.description: List the notes on a lead's phone that this account wrote, newest first (up to 50). Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/leads/{id}/notes.

tools.name: maxcrm_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments, newest first. Filter by first and last date (YYYY-MM-DD) or by lead. Page with next_cursor. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/appointments.

tools.name: maxcrm_list_activity
tools.title: List activity
tools.description: Read the newest-first feed of status changes, notes, calls and texts for this account's leads. Page with next_cursor. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/activity.

since.description: Only events at or after this time.

tools.name: maxcrm_create_lead
tools.title: Create a lead
tools.description: Add one lead to the account. Give a phone and a first or last name. A phone already on file returns DUPLICATE_PHONE with the existing lead id. The account's own new-lead rules (drip, first messages, consent) apply. Max CRM API: POST /api/v1/leads.

status.description: Pipeline status, for example new_lead or appointment_scheduled. maxcrm_get_reference lists them all.

source.description: Where the lead came from, free text, for example "Facebook Ad".

lead_type.description: final_expense, term, iul, annuities, general, retirement, real_estate, auto_insurance or custom.

do_not_call.description: true stops calls and the drip.

notes.description: The first note on the lead.

tools.name: maxcrm_update_lead
tools.title: Update a lead
tools.description: Change some fields of one lead. Changing status goes through the same rules as the CRM and can start its automations. Fields not given stay as they are. Max CRM API: PATCH /api/v1/leads/{id}.

phone.description: Phone number, 7 to 15 digits. Unique within the account.

status.description: Pipeline status, for example new_lead or appointment_scheduled. maxcrm_get_reference lists them all.

source.description: Where the lead came from, free text, for example "Facebook Ad".

lead_type.description: final_expense, term, iul, annuities, general, retirement, real_estate, auto_insurance or custom.

do_not_call.description: true stops calls and the drip.

tools.name: maxcrm_add_lead_note
tools.title: Add a lead note
tools.description: Add one activity note to a lead's phone. The CRM keeps 25 notes per phone (NOTE_LIMIT_REACHED after that). Max CRM API: POST /api/v1/leads/{id}/notes.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Max CRM
prompts.description: What you can do with Max CRM here, with example requests to try.
